author: smuzaffar
body:
Move the executable code in `compare_using_files.py` into a main() function and add an if __name__ == "__main__": guard.

This prevents the comparison script from being executed again when multiprocessing re-imports the main module, fixing the RuntimeError encountered with Python 3.14's default forkserver start method. 

The real change without white spaces is https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52324/changes?w=1 

This should fix the dqm comparison errors we get in [Python 3.14](https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/jenkins-artifacts/baseLineComparisons/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-28-1100+b96614/81503/38434.911_TTbar_14TeV+Run4D128_DD4hepRelMonComp-38434.911.log)
